title: SkillsCatalogResult
description: Output contract for the skills_catalog MetaprojectOperation. Draft — see docs/requirements/keryx-skills-runtime-tools/specification.md section 3.1.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the live filesystem read. Never a cache-write timestamp — see decisions.md D-02.

path.description: Project-relative path to the skill's SKILL.md, e.g. ".metaproject/skills/gdskills/orchestration/flow-orchestrator/SKILL.md".

category.description: Derived from the containing directory; mirrors BundledSkill.category in src/gdskills/catalog.ts (core, orchestration, review, quality, planning, platform).

description.description: From SKILL.md frontmatter `description`, falling back to catalog.md's one-line summary.
